Okay, let's go over the ground rules. You can't leave first until you chug a beer. Any man scoring has to chug a beer. You have to chug a beer at the top of all odd numbered innings. Oh, and the fourth inning is the beer inning.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hey, we know how to play softball.
I'm right here, Chief!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Oh. Then where's Sideshow Bob?
Take him out!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: My bad. I can't work my answering machine either. Now I need a new informant. Say, Lisa, people trust you. How'd you like to be a snitch? The pay stinks, but--

Thank you. As Montgomery Burns' closest friend, I am certain that there is nothing he would want more than swift, brutal revenge against Homer Simpson. Therefore, I am offering a $50,000 reward for his capture. Dead or alive.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Me first! Me first!
Good lord!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Put out an APB on a Uosdwis R. Dewoh. Better start with Greektown.
Father, I'm not a Catholic, but... well, I tried to march in the St. Patrick's Day parade... Anyway, I've got a... rather large sin to confess. I'm the one who... who shot Mr. Burns.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: That's all I needed to hear. Boy, this thing works great.
Join us, join us, join us...

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Do not sanctify that witch!
And turn! And flex! And shake! And bounce! And turn! And flex! And shake! And bounce!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Now Sideshow Bob can't get in without me knowing. And once a man is in your home, anything you do to him is nice and legal.
Everybody wants it done yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Now we're ordering lunch. Wanna go halvesies on a pizza?
Don't worry, ma'am. He's not connected to the power supply, so he can't go far. Gulp.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hey, hey, hey! Oh, he's got us in a corner. I hate this ride!
I lied about being kidnapped. The whole thing was a hoax.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: A hoax? A hoax?
Chief Wiggum, you've been around. You don't trust Sideshow Bob, do you?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Ahh, lighten up, son. If he was going to commit a crime, would he have invited the No. 1 cop in town? Now, where did I put my gun? Oh, yeah. I set it down when I got a piece of cake...
Or isn't there not?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, Sven-golly. You're gonna untangle this guy's noodle and that's it. No more hypnotizing anyone.
Gotta go!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, boys. Let's get this tape back to the lab for analysis.
Blonde guys aren't dumb. They're evil. Like in "The Karate Kid" and World War Two.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, boys. Let's see the dark underbelly of our fair burg.
Yes, Chief Wiggum.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: And Snake, do you see what happens when you kidnap the President?
A deal's a deal.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: And you'll stay till we cut the cake.
Aw, rats, another gutter ball! Gee, Homer, you sure do suck tonight!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Aw, geez. I don't have anything to do anymore. With Banner around, alcohol and crime are history in this town. And so am I.
There's no such thing as a boogeyman!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Boogie boogie boogie boogie boogie!
You got it!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Damn. All right, boys, roll up the sound truck. We'll blast 'em out with music.
Wait. Wait. Wait. Bob can't stay with us. This man has tried to kill me so much it's not funny anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Don't worry son, we have ways of making him compliant.
Fine. I want one gift bag now, and one when the party's over.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Fine. You got it.
Not to worry, at this school, we've got a clean slate. In fact, I'm establishing my cred right now.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Gotcha! Take this as a warning, kids. Bart Simpson is the ultimate bad boy. Befriend him and you'll wind up just like him -- a rebel who does what he wants, when he wants. Wow. Come on, tough guy -- let's go.
I won't be happy until I find out what you're up to. Wherever you go and whatever you do, I'll be there watching and waiting.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: He says that, but I bet he gives up pretty quickly.
Why are we really waiting for Dad?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Heh, forty-eight dollars and seventy cents... You know we don't usually take rusty money.
Turn the music off!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Heh, it's working like a charm, boys! Now cut the power and hit 'em with the lights!
Constable Wiggum likes to act tough. But he also likes to walk the beat in control-top pantyhose?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Heh. Heh. Well, It's not like that's a crime.
Hmmm. Wow! Dad's been in jail six times. Aw, and Mom's only been in twice.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hello, Sarah? Ralphie? It's me, Chief Wiggum.
Oh geez, I'm sorry. I wish there was some way we could both have a dog.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hello... Police... Aw, man, if this one's not the right house, I quit.
We'll be safe in here!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Here we are, 123 Fake Street. The home of knifey wifey.
Come on, boy, let's go home and have some fun. That cat's been strutting around like she owns the place...

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hey, hey, Lou! Don't bogart that medicine!
Charlie, you'd rat on me?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hey, no, no, what do you think you're--
But... what about Milhouse's Dad?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hey, this is the best thing that ever happened to that loser. Women love famous felons.
No! You can't take him now! We've only been on two rides!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hey, you should've used Fast Pass!
All you have to do is sign a paper that says I can have your soul. I need a soul, Ralph. Any soul. Yours.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hey. What's goin' on over there?!
Kill, kill, kill!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hold it right there, Bart! Can you tell us anything about who did this?
As a graffiti artist, there're so many people to thank... people who build walls... nighttime, for being dark...

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hold it right there, Spray-candy Warhol!
What a great Christmas. Not even Moe's annual suicide attempt can ruin it.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: I ain't got all day, Drama Queen, get it over with!
You're right. I'll do it.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: I love this song.
Please don't call our parents!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: I'm afraid I have to for hijinks like these. Heh. "Hijinks." Funny word. Three dotted letters in a row.
Commissioner Wiggum, I need to confess something.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Is it that you're proud of me?
So why'd you come here? I run a respectable treehouse.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Just wondering if you've seen anything. Word is you'll, uh, you'll snitch for candy.
Now can we go home?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Laddie saved the day, Simpson. Boy, we sure could use a dog like that on the force.
You can't do that to Duncan. It's not his fault that his owner was a sleaze.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Look, I just want the horse to have a good home, or be food. You want to take him, fine with me.
You can't buy me with a candy bar that has coconut.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Maybe this is more your neighborhood.
I saw a guy with a gun and a snake tattoo say he was gonna hide out on top of Mount Springfield.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Mount Springfield, eh? Strap on your crampons, boys!
Well, I'd hate to tell the number one cop in town how to do his job.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: No, no, please. It's the only way I'll learn.
Uh, Chief... is Milhouse's Dad gonna be in trouble? He's not really a bad guy.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Now, now, there's no need for you to defend your captor, Bratty Hearst.
Ah, that's gotta hoit!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Oh my God, someone's taken a bite outta the big Rice Krispy Square. Oh, yeah. And the waiter's been brutally beaten.
It's us, the Simpsons.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Oh. I saw your car by the gate and I, well I thought you might be lost hikers. 'Cause then I could rescue you, and-and be a hero, and-and maybe the city would give me a coupon for free guitar lessons ha.
Quick, in here!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Oh. Man, we have got to get an escalator.
So you see, Chief, Snake wasn't stealing that stuff out of greed. He was stealing it to thank me.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Plea denied! Warm up the electric chair, Lou!
Wait, Chief. I must know... who tipped you off?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Probably shouldn't tell you this, but it was our undercover officer... Shepard Fairey.
Sorry, Chief. Uhm, we were just playing.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Ralphie, you got a friend? That's fantastic. Here, here, have some riot gear, it's on the house.
Why don't you guys take him. I thought he was the right dog for me, but I guess I made a mistake.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Really? No foolin'? Aw, gee, thanks, mister. We'll take real good care of him and we'll play with him every day. Honest!
Chief Wiggum shows us crime photos at sleepovers.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: So this is what a body looks like after it drops sixty stories. Come on, Milhouse. Don't pretend you're asleep. This is the world we live in! Yeah.
Nice real estate. You've got a deal.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: So, what do you know?
Lousy surface dwellers...

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: So, what seems to be the problem?
Restraining order?! Bull spit! No piece of paper keeps me from whaling on my sister.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: So, you see what happens when you don't obey your restraining order?
Yes.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: So, you thought you'd pull a fake wedding, eh? You're under arrest.
Well, finally, a little luck.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Son, you wait here while daddy tries to talk some sense into this raving derelict.
Now to turn on the moto-mimic.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Sounds like a motorcycle gang! And we don't have back-up. We better lay low.
Fast Pass can't solve everything!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Spoken like a kid who's never lived in a non-Fast Pass world.
Only the coolest kid ever could think of that! Good golly, Sven-Golly! You did it!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Sven-Golly, born Svenjamin Golly, you are under arrest for mesmerizing the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame to induct Kiss.
Good morning, world! Eat my shorts!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: There'll be no shorts eaten today, young man.
Ah, three it is.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: This better be important, Lisa. I left Ralphie alone in the bathtub.
But Gandhi also said "less talk, more rock"!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Uh-oh. All the lights are out. We'd better get the entire force workin' on this.
People, please. The only way Lisa can bust me is if she finds someone who can prove I was at that rap show. And I know just where she can find that someone. Let's go cover our asses!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Wait, before we go, I took the liberty of making these embroidered conspiracy jackets for all of us.
I need to know that Chalmers will be taken care of!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: We don't negotiate with terrorists! Or the people that supply our uniforms and weapons. We just pay whatever they say.
Juvie?! Please Judge, you can't... I-I'll do anything! I'll squeal on my dad -- he's been up to bad things. Crap you'VE never even thought of.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: We've already got an informer working deep cover on your dad. One he'll never suspect.
Chief Wiggum, think you have room in your jail for a two-time loser?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Well no, frankly, but that never stopped us before.
Sir, I know what I wanna be when I grow up. A cop!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Well, until then, son, I'm gonna make you an honorary police officer... Eddie, give him your badge.
My plan was to lie. Lie like hell. And that's what I did.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Well, well. Seems like someone forgot about a previous engagement at the bowling alley from two to four-thirty.
C'mon Chief, it was just a prank. Would some flatware make things right?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: What does it say on my badge?
It was?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Yeah. Do you think people would be stupid enough to pay for something some amateur put on a wall for nothing?
Hootie and the Blowfish?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Yeah. It's cheaper than blank tape.
Wow! You are so much cooler than Milhouse's mom.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Yeah. Way to channel that rage, Simpson.
Crank it, Homer.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: You busted up that crack house pretty bad, McGarnigal. Did you really have to break so much furniture?
Thanks a lot, Chief.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: You kids crack me up.
So what's the charge, Chief? Vandalism? Smoking?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: You know what you did, Muntz. Burglary and arson. You're goin' away for a long time.
You know-it-know it, Neddy.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: You see anything yet?
My Gloria is still inside! Save her!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Ah, it's too dangerous! Ah-- But I got a sister you might like. She's completely hairless, like those cats.
Beep beep! Out of my way, I'm a motorist!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Ahh, that's some nice reckless driving, Mr. B!
It's the principle, Smithers! Nobody steals from Montgomery Burns, whether it be my Sunday newspaper or my loutish oaf of a son.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, Mr. B, when the kidnappers call with the ransom demand, you tell them you'll leave the money under the big net in the park.
I've been expecting this day for thirty years. In a way, it's a relief. But in another way, it's most unwelcome.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, quit stallin', Burns. Who'd you ice?
Gentlemen, my prison is losing money. We need more convicts in the dungeonareum.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Dungeonareum. That's catchy. Well, I could beef up arrests by enforcing some of these old forgotten laws.
Hurry up and get in -- I'll drive.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Hurry everyone, roll in the shards!
What are you doing in my corpse-hatch?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Montgomery Burns, you're under arrest for murder.
LET'S ALL GO TO THE LOBBY, LET'S ALL GO TO THE LOBBY, LET'S ALL GO TO THE LOBBY, GET OURSELVES SOME SNACKS...

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Now what are the two things? Enunciate and energate.
Wh... where are you taking me? What's happening?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Relax. You've gone off your nut, so we're stuffing you into an old folks home. Those, uh, store guys signed the commitment papers.
Hot tub? Media room? It's supposed to be a power plant, not Aunt Beulah's Bordello. Thank you. Get out. Next.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Uh, Ralphy, get off the stage! Sweetheart!
I see. Well, what if I cover you all with... a cube of bulletproof plexi-glass!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Uh, it's pretty much the same thing.
The electric chair is on, eh? Then the old prison has been getting free electricity for thirty years. I'll put a stop to that.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Wow! That was really entertaining! How'd you make that smoke?
I don't care if she's Miss Hairless America... I'm spoken for. Now step aside -- I'll save Gloria myself.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Y-- You? Ah, no offense, but you're a decrepit monkey skeleton.
I' afraid that's insufficient. Officer, arrest the baby.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Yeah right pops. No jury in the world is gonna convict a baby. Mmm... except maybe Texas.
If I knock him out, I'll be a hero. And people will listen to my loose-brained nonsense.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: By the shores of Gitche Gumee, / By the shining Big-Sea-Water, / Stood the Wiggum of Nokomis... I'm sorry, did I just say "Wiggum?" I meant "wigwam." Yeah lemme uh, lemme start again.
Dead, dead, dead, dead...

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: First of all, I'd like to ask if anyone has any questions.
That's right. We all gotta stick together if we're gonna have any hope of bringing that awful Homer to justice.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Here is a photo of the fugitive from our files.
On what charge?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Making a Police Chief go.
No, the Hindu guy.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: NEVER GONNA SEE YOU ANY...
Go ahead! I ain't afraid of no prison!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Sir, we're gonna bring you back to your retirement home.
Um... yes?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: We're still not close. Boy, this is gonna be an all-night brain buster. Better drink some coffee.
Come back with my thumb!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: 911, this better be good.
Hello, police? Are you sitting down? Good. I wish to report a robbery!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: A robbery, right. Thanks for the report.
Hello, Chief.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Afternoon, Homer. Care for some chili? I've added an extra ingredient just for you. The merciless peppers of Quetzlzacatenango!
Hello, Officer!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Afternoon, ma'am. What is it about a woman in a dumpster?
Yeah, we could start our own game, where people throw ducks at balloons, and nothing's the way it seems.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Ah, I hate to interrupt your fun, boys...
You found my baby. Oh, thank you, thank you, thank you!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Ah, shucks. Just don't do it again, you big lug.
Chauffeur's license, eh? Mel, buckle your borscht belt!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Ah, since you're trying to make a getaway in park, I'm guessing you don't have a license. Better head down to the DMV. These two broads'll help you out.
Yes there is, there's a garage full of counterfeit jeans.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Ah, they've uh, mysteriously, uh, disappeared.
It's just no fun without Marge.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Ahhh. There's nothing like moonshine from your own still.
I went on for hours and they were hanging on my every word. I really think I was born to teach.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right Simpson, you were warned about teasing the box.
I repeat: unable to exercise...

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right look, Simpson... there is one thing you can do to get out sooner... but, uh, it is extremely dangerous.
No, I just thought it was cute when you called him...

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, "Max Power." Eddie, swab this joker's eyes with mace.
Fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight, fight.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, I'm going to make a little deal with you mugs. I'm gonna let you all out to see my team play the hockey game if you promise to return to your cells.
Okay. Half of you vibrate that way, two of you fall down, Nelson, you just spin around in a circle.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, I've got an arrest warrant here for a Nelson Muntz. Uh, which one of you little punks is Muntz?
I choose to waive that right.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, Simpson, you're free to go.
I'm doing this for my family!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, breaking baddies, drop the meth!
Well, I bet there's drug dresses and drug vacuum cleaners, too!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, listen up. L-listen up! These prestigious wrought-iron security gates are bullet-proof, bomb-proof, and battering ram-resistant. Now...
Mmm. Incapacitating.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, settle people. People settle. People. Wood and Van Zuylen, stake out Donutland. When they fry up a fresh batch, call it in. Keneally and Erhart, back 'em up.
Oh sure. Single me out.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, smart guy. Where's the fire?
Okay, left hand: Rembrandt!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, step away from the old masters and kick 'em over here. Come on.
It's a ring toss game.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, that's it. I'm shutting this game down.
That's what I'm saying! See Marge, this guy gets it.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, what's goin' on here?
Aw, thanks, honey.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: All right, you scrawny beanpoles, becoming a cop is not something that happens overnight... it takes one solid weekend of training to get that badge.
What?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Alright men, here's the order of deportations. First we'll be rounding up your tired, then your poor, then your huddled masses yearning to breathe free.
From fast food to fine dining?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: And everything in between.
I'm fine.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Attention, Brotherhood of the Spectacles: you are ordered to immediately evacuate the school, and then return to school where you belong.
Let's see. Sweatbands... check. Anti-chafing nipple tape... Check, check... and check.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Attention, runners. On your mark, get set, now get outta here before I change my mind.
God bless America!

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Aw, Cinnamon. Don't make this harder than it already is.
Oh yeah -- sorry I was such a jerk about it.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Aw, now, who could blame you? Your sports team lost. Yeah. Well I'll see you at Moe's.
Don't worry, kids. I know just what to do. Jumanji! Does anything from the movies actually work?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Aw, nuts. Isn't there anybody who can round up these thunder lizards?
Just a second.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Beautiful. Eddie, did you trace the phone number?
Sorry Sarah, I'm retired.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: But tonight's the Policemen's Ball! And if you let my Sarah down I can make life very difficult for you.
U.S.A.! U.S.A.! U.S.A...

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Carl Lewis, I could kiss you.
Angry nut coming through.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Clear a path, boys.
You can lock us away, but you'll never defeat the Cobras.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Cobras? I thought you were the Hell's Satans.
Is it Lenny?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Dammit! I mean... uh no. No.
Mmmm...

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Do not be alarmed. Continue swimming naked. Aw, come on. Continue. Come on, aw. All right, Lou, open fire.
Now that he's had a taste of human flesh, the dog will be a slave to its succulence! Look at him eyeing me -- he knows I taste best.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Don't blame the dog, folks. A cop's life is so intense, he has to channel it somewhere. Me, I knit violent imagery.
Um, has the ship sailed on my foot massage suggestion?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Don't worry, Mr. Burns. We'll track down Simpson with your vehicle's anti-theft system.
Mmm, steamed Gentile.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Don't worry, us pigs will catch this killer. Now Mr. Simpson, is it possible you're living a double or triple life that your wife doesn't know about?
My wife's having a girls' night out.

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Eh, just get one of those inflatable women. But make sure it's a woman... 'Cause one time I... Eh come on, I'll uh... I'll give you a ride home.
Huh? What'd I do?

dialogue.speaker: Chief Wiggum
dialogue.text: Failed to separate your bottles and newspapers.
Flanders!
